title: Cloud Cost
content:
A Power BI app has been create to give an overview of IPEX cloud related costs. You need to have a subscription to be able to access the report. Please contact IKEA@comparex-group.com to get a Power BI license. License has to be approved by you manager .

The owner of the cloud account(s) for a product is accountable for generated costs and have access to all costs via the current cloud portal and any custom reporting created by the product team.

It is recommended to create a group of persons that are able to interpret costs and act on deviations. This group should get warnings when budget limit is passed or other cost related KPI:s are breached.

Azure related costs

Available in Power BI report and for the product team via cloud portal.

AWS related costs

Available in Power BI report and for the product team via cloud portal.

GCP related costs

Available in Power BI report and for the product team via cloud portal.

AliCloud

Currently only available for product team via cloud portal.
